title: DB Migration Runner Compiler
description: Compiles database migration execution config (pipeline jobs, K8s Jobs). Enforces: migration directory exists, runner config validates, command from approved allowlist, credentials injected via env/secrets, ordering policy explicit.

error_codes.MR001: db-migration-runner-spec.json missing — required: command, migrationDir, orderingPolicy
error_codes.MR002: Migration directory does not exist or contains no migration files
error_codes.MR003: Migration command not in approved allowlist
error_codes.MR004: Database credentials provided as literal values instead of env refs
error_codes.MR005: Ordering policy not declared: must be pre-deploy, deploy, or post-deploy
